notes: Spanish gets the same deep native-style audit every other course already went through: nearly 300 corrections across all 250 lessons, the full vocabulary deck, and the mock DELE exams, including grammar explanations that quietly contradicted themselves, a couple of exam facts that were just wrong, and exercises where the hint gave away the answer. Every course also got a small fix for a bug where multiple-choice explanations could point at the wrong answer after the choices got shuffled on screen. French's and Italian's vocabulary decks grow again to close out their frequency-coverage targets, and an unverifiable citation on the Portuguese deck was removed.
